teaser.en: A scrambling bush-vine with two Digo names and round orange fruits.
teaser.sw: Kichaka-mtambaa chenye majina mawili ya Kidigo na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya machungwa.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaoambala dzulu ya vitsaka, wenye madzina mairi ga Chidigo na matunda ga duara ga rangi ya chungbwa.

summary.en: Mdoma, also called mwambaro, is a scrambling shrub or liana of the Celastraceae family. It has leathery leaves and round orange fruits.
summary.sw: Mdoma, unaoitwa pia *mwambaro*, ni kichaka kinachotambaa au mtambaa wa familia ya Celastraceae. Una majani magumu kama ngozi na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya machungwa.
summary.dg: *Mdoma*, unaoihwa piya *mwambaro*, ni chitsaka chinachoambala au mmea unaokpwera wa jamii ya *Celastraceae*. Una makodza magumu dza chingo na matunda ga duara ga rangi ya chungbwa.

about.en: Mdoma is a scrambling shrub or woody climber that leans on and twines through other vegetation. Its leaves are opposite, leathery and glossy, often with slightly toothed edges. Small greenish-yellow flowers grow in clusters in the leaf axils. They are followed by round fruits that ripen orange to red, with a few seeds in a soft, sweet pulp.
about.sw: Mdoma ni kichaka kinachotambaa au mtambaa wenye shina la mti unaoegemea na kujiviringa katikati ya mimea mingine. Majani yake hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana, ni magumu kama ngozi na yanang'aa, mara nyingi yakiwa na meno madogo pembeni. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-manjano huota katika vishada kwenye kwapa za majani. Hufuatwa na matunda ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya machungwa hadi mekundu, yenye mbegu chache ndani ya nyama laini na tamu.
about.dg: *Mdoma* ni chitsaka chinachoambala au mmea unaokpwera wenye kolo ra muhi, unaojejemera na kulinga-linga kahi ya mimea yanjina. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganalolana, ni magumu dza chingo na ganang'ala, na mara nyinji gana meno madide kanda-kanda. Maruwa madide ga chijani na mandano ganamera kpwa mabunda phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na panda. Badaye ganalavya matunda ga duara ganayoiva na kukala rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu, genye tembe chache ndani ya nyama laini ya mtswano.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, thicket and bushland in eastern Africa and Madagascar.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka na nyika ya vichaka mashariki mwa Afrika na Madagaska.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani, vitsakani na weruni, Afrika ya Mashariki na Madagascar.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. In eastern and southern Africa the pulp of *Salacia* fruits is eaten as a wild snack.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika nyama ya matunda ya *Salacia* huliwa kama kitafunio cha porini.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika kazi yoyosi. Afrika ya Mashariki na kusini ya Afrika, nyama ya matunda ga *Salacia* nkuriwa dza chakurya chidide cha weruni.

names.en: Digo: *mdoma* and *mwambaro*. Pakia records both only for Digo and gives no meaning for either. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdoma* na *mwambaro*. Pakia anayarekodi yote mawili kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana ya lolote kati yao. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdoma* na *mwambaro*. Pakia anaandika madzina gosi mairi kpwa Chidigo tu, na kapha mana ya dzina hata rimwenga. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.
